isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged Angola lexicon here. Angola Contruy, Umbundu, Kimbundu, and Kikongo are separate datasets under this folder. Do not copy between them. Do not copy Angolar / Ngola of São Tomé. Kikongo of Angola is not Kituba.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query a named language folder under data/angola_dataset/. A merged Angola lexicon is not stored at this path.

license.source_extracts: Cited academic sources retain their original terms. See each language sources.md.

extraction_notes: Parent index of Angola languages. Lexicon is stored only in the language folders, and only from sources that name that language. APiCS 36 is Angolar of São Tomé and was not copied here.
